      static com.google.gson.JsonArray build(EngineeringProject project, com.google.gson.JsonArray reliefChecks, com.google.gson.JsonArray sequences)
      Builds equipment rows, keeping unevaluated components and unresolved device references visible.
      Parameters:
      project - engineering model with device declarations
      reliefChecks - calculated installed-device screens
      sequences - evaluated sequences with source actions and any recorded dynamic verdict
      Returns:
      equipment protection review in process order

    • function

      private static com.google.gson.JsonObject function(Api14cDeviceDeclaration device, com.google.gson.JsonArray reliefChecks, com.google.gson.JsonArray sequences)
      Resolves exact device and sequence references within one protected equipment boundary.
      Parameters:
      device - declaration supported by a project record
      reliefChecks - installation screens by device and equipment
      sequences - shutdown evidence by sequence and equipment
      Returns:
      declared function with traceability and explicit missing evidence

    • matches

      private static com.google.gson.JsonArray matches(com.google.gson.JsonArray rows, String equipmentField, String equipment, String idField, String id)
      Finds exact matches so that ambiguous or mismatched records cannot supply verification.
      Parameters:
      rows - existing calculation records
      equipmentField - equipment key
      equipment - equipment value
      idField - device or sequence key
      id - device or sequence identifier
      Returns:
      all matching records
